independent_physics_check.method: Evaluator's own script (scratchpad indep_check.py, not tools/journey_ref.py): 45-digit Decimal from first-principles derivation of the rocket equations, boost-cruise-brake, flip fallback, photon-drive m c^2 phi, specular-sphere ISM drag n sinh^2(phi) m_p c^2 pi R^2, ship-frame drag energy F c tau = n sinh(phi) m_p c^2 pi R^2 d, load/kinetic flux, glow eps f_in K/4, forward Doppler e^phi, atanh(1-e) = ln((2-e)/e)/2

numerics.cosh-1 vs 2sinh^2(phi/2) at phi=1e-6: cosh-1 = 5.000444502911705e-13 (4 digits); 2 sinh^2 = 5.000000000000417e-13 (true 5.00000000000041666e-13). The new low-speed row is the right kill; the plan's 'row 3' claim could not kill it (phi 7.25 has no cancellation)
numerics.acosh(1+u) vs acosh1p at u=5e-10: acosh(1+u) = 3.162277790860629e-05 vs acosh1p 3.162277660036618e-05 (true 3.16227766003661776e-05, 8 digits lost). Row 4 has a d/2 = 387, not small, so it could not kill this mutation; the new short-flip row does
numerics.rapidityOfOneMinusBeta: atanh(1-e) at e=1e-6 fails row 3 at 1e-12 (my mutation A6: 4 tests fail), so the never-form-1-beta rule is load-bearing and tested
numerics.motionAt brake error claim: measured at 0.99c, tau = tau2 + tauBurn/2: |phi64 - phiDecimal| = 6.7e-11 absolute; a*ulp(tauTotal) = 8.6e-11; 5.1e-11 relative to local phi, 2.5e-11 relative to phiPeak. PR's '~a*ulp(tauTotal), ~3e-11 relative' is correct in magnitude (its 'relative' is to phiPeak). Boundaries and arrival are exact as claimed
numerics.NaN: clampTau treats NaN as 0; planBurnCoastBurn(NaN) takes the fallback via not(2 dBurn < d); brakeHoldsAgainstDrag tests NaN first. VM = interpreter confirmed through journeyDigest

deviations_judged.verdict: ACCEPT. The design's 16-17 digit readout table reproduces only with these (CODATA 2022 shifts drag by 1.35e-9 relative, canon's 4-digit constants by ~1e-9); canon HB digits are unaffected. Design doc said 'CODATA' without a year; the package now pins it in code and CHANGELOG. Follow-up (docs): state the CODATA year in the design doc's medium constants line

All additive and documented in AGENT.md
